verdict.rationale: Automatic image captioning is a fair question for an LLM-oriented web crawler, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents generating captions or descriptions for page images. Screenshot capture and generic LLM-based structured extraction are adjacent features or building blocks, not an image-captioning capability.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can get automatic captions for images on a page so a text-only model can reason about visual content
